rule: Per checkpoint, over all tested alpha (coarse + fine) on the 72 sweep cells only: maximise qualifying laps; ties -> more completed laps; remaining ties -> the alpha closest to the middle of the contiguous alpha range that is within 1 qualifying lap of the maximum (robustness). For 1.25M the best alpha < 1 under the same rule is also kept as a challenger. Reference settings evaluated alongside: 1.25M/alpha=1 (published baseline) and 2.5M/alpha=1.
